purpose: Low-context search index. Load matched runtime cards, not the full registry.

components.name: Progressive Context Intake
components.purpose: Protect limited active context by progressively disclosing sources and transferring verified evidence into compact indexed state before higher-level decisions.
components.trigger: many sources or modules compete for attention
components.avoid: a short single source fits comfortably in context

components.name: Adapter-First Experimentation
components.purpose: Protect a working OS or workflow from speculative capabilities while preserving a path for evidence-based evolution.
components.trigger: a new capability may destabilize a base workflow
components.avoid: the change is a mandatory security repair

components.name: Anti-Tunnel Vision
components.purpose: Preserve enough search breadth to expose premature fixation, then collapse quickly when evidence discriminates.
components.trigger: premature fixation could hide credible alternatives
components.avoid: the answer is directly established by a locked source
task_phrases: architecture choice with two credible patterns

components.name: Modular System Design Orchestrator
components.purpose: Plan and coordinate modular system design from goal discovery through critique, localized repair, synthesis, and continuation state.
components.trigger: designing or refactoring a Skill, OS, framework, or workflow
components.avoid: the task is a narrow domain execution job with no architecture decision

components.name: Temporary Focused-Context View
components.purpose: Reduce attention burden while retaining the facts, constraints, provenance, and retrieval pointers required by the current subtask.
components.trigger: source volume exceeds the active workspace
components.avoid: the original context is already small

components.name: Capability and Completion Honesty Gate
components.purpose: Keep process-status and completion claims auditable, especially when the host lacks a requested source, tool, persistent state, or execution capability.
components.trigger: claims about evidence, actions, or completion are emitted
components.avoid: the output makes no claim about evidence, actions, capability, or completion

components.name: Authority Anchor Enforcement
components.purpose: Bind consequential decisions and state changes to an explicit governing authority so lower-priority modules cannot silently override them.
components.trigger: multiple instruction authorities coexist and may conflict
components.avoid: the workflow has no competing instruction or authority layers

components.name: Reusable Behavior Component Builder
components.purpose: Turn repeatable behavior, logic, evidence handling, and output contracts into swappable components that compose with Cores and validators.
components.trigger: a recurring task family needs reusable behavior
components.avoid: the content is primarily domain knowledge

components.name: Bidirectional Consistency
components.purpose: Expose lossy, non-invertible, or spuriously plausible transformations that one-way review misses.
components.trigger: causal, logical, quantitative, or evidence claims are central
components.avoid: the transformation is intentionally irreversible and no reverse contract is claimed

components.name: Bounded Iteration Stop Rule
components.purpose: Turn iterative improvement into a terminating control loop with explicit quality, budget, and diminishing-return gates.
components.trigger: a draft needs iterative improvement
components.avoid: a mandatory validator has not yet passed

components.name: Citation Fidelity Gate
components.purpose: Ensure citations prove the precise nearby claim instead of functioning as decorative evidence.
components.trigger: output contains citations or source-attributed claims
components.avoid: the output contains no externally attributed factual claims

components.name: Clarification Gateway
components.purpose: Keep clarification proportional: ask only for materially blocking information, otherwise continue with the narrowest explicit assumption or bounded partial result.
components.trigger: required variables are missing or instructions conflict
components.avoid: the missing detail cannot change a valid result

components.name: Reasoning Effort Budget Controller
components.purpose: Prevent both expensive overthinking of trivial work and unsafe underchecking of consequential work.
components.trigger: effort allocation materially affects cost or quality
components.avoid: a mandatory protocol fixes the review budget

components.name: Periodic Whole-Task Consistency Check
components.purpose: Detect long-horizon drift early without rerunning a full review after every step.
components.trigger: a workflow is long or multi-stage
components.avoid: the task completes in one obvious operation

components.name: Coherence Loops
components.purpose: Repair cross-part inconsistencies while preventing endless self-review.
components.trigger: local edits risk global inconsistency
components.avoid: the discrepancy is isolated and a single deterministic correction suffices

components.name: Runtime-Adaptive Drift Checks
components.purpose: Maintain semantic reliability across weak and strong runtimes without burdening every runtime identically.
components.trigger: compute/depth varies across a task
components.avoid: adaptation would weaken factual or safety invariants

components.name: Contradiction Micro-Repair Pack
components.purpose: Resolve direct logical or factual inconsistency while preserving every compatible claim and locked constraint.
components.trigger: a localized contradiction is detected
components.avoid: the apparent contradiction is a legitimate difference in scope or time
task_phrases: state snapshots with mutually exclusive flags
documents whose conclusion contradicts a cited premise

components.name: Bounded Change Rules
components.purpose: Enable adaptation, compression, or creativity without surrendering semantic control.
components.trigger: synthesis or creativity must coexist with fidelity
components.avoid: all content is zero-drift

components.name: Auditable Reasoning State
components.purpose: Make reasoning-relevant state portable and auditable while preserving the boundary between useful state and hidden internal deliberation.
components.trigger: structured intermediate task state must survive across steps
components.avoid: a one-turn answer has no meaningful state

components.name: Counterfactual Integrity Gate
components.purpose: Make counterfactual exploration safe and auditable by preserving an explicit boundary between factual, evaluative, framing, and hypothetical phases.
components.trigger: counterfactual or hypothetical reasoning is used
components.avoid: the task contains no hypothetical branch
task_phrases: creative work mixed with factual sources

components.name: No-Unrequested-Scenarios Guard
components.purpose: Protect factual extraction and reporting tasks from unsolicited counterfactual elaboration.
components.trigger: factual output could be contaminated by hypothetical content
components.avoid: the task explicitly requests scenarios, hypotheses, or counterfactual analysis

components.name: Precision Local System Edit
components.purpose: Make high-confidence micro-edits to structured systems without collateral semantic or interface drift.
components.trigger: a change is small and local
components.avoid: the governing structure is wrong
task_phrases: one rule change in a prompt or skill

components.name: Critical Fact Verification
components.purpose: Concentrate verification on the smallest facts whose failure would invalidate the output.
components.trigger: small factual errors could change the outcome
components.avoid: no factual conclusion or consequential action depends on the output

components.name: Cross-Checking Chains
components.purpose: Make validation ordered, traceable, and resistant to repeated correlated checking.
components.trigger: a conclusion relies on a dependency chain
components.avoid: one direct authoritative check fully resolves a low-risk atom

components.name: Cross-Context Relationship Guard
components.purpose: Preserve an explicitly declared relationship between related contexts without blending their facts, authority, or unresolved assumptions.
components.trigger: related contexts must stay aligned across a long task
components.avoid: the contexts are unrelated

components.name: Alternative-Scenario Consistency Check
components.purpose: Prevent a final synthesis from combining mutually exclusive premises harvested from different candidate worlds.
components.trigger: parallel candidate paths are compared
components.avoid: only one branch was explored

components.name: Decision-First Scaffold
components.purpose: Keep analysis shaped around a decision, options, and decision criteria rather than accumulating directionless detail.
components.trigger: analysis risks becoming directionless before commitment
components.avoid: the task asks only for faithful extraction or description

components.name: Shared Domain Knowledge Component Builder
components.purpose: Give multiple behaviors a shared, sourced domain substrate without duplicating knowledge across Genes or turning a Core into an OS.
components.trigger: a recurring domain needs structured knowledge and decision logic
components.avoid: the need is purely behavioral

components.name: Domain / Mode Isolation
components.purpose: Prevent cross-domain contamination while permitting explicit, reviewed transfers of shared facts.
components.trigger: multiple domains or semantic modes coexist
components.avoid: the task is genuinely single-domain

components.name: Domain-Calibrated Change Tolerance
components.purpose: Avoid applying casual creative tolerance to precision domains or unnecessary rigidity to expressive domains.
components.trigger: domains have materially different fidelity needs
components.avoid: domain is ambiguous and stakes are high

components.name: Dominant-Driver Isolation Scaffold
components.purpose: Separate high-leverage causes or constraints from correlated, downstream, or low-impact factors.
components.trigger: many plausible causes compete for priority
components.avoid: the system is known to require irreducibly joint causes

components.name: Downstream Invariant Protection
components.purpose: Preserve established drift resistance across pipelines rather than only at the original source boundary.
components.trigger: many downstream modules consume locked decisions
components.avoid: no downstream artifact derives from protected material

components.name: Retired-Branch Quarantine
components.purpose: Stop known drift attractors from repeatedly re-entering active reasoning without destroying potentially useful history.
components.trigger: discarded branches repeatedly re-enter active reasoning
components.avoid: the branch is unresolved rather than rejected
task_phrases: agent workflows with recurring stale branches

components.name: Content-Specific Change Tolerance
components.purpose: Allocate strictness where meaning is fragile and flexibility where variation is valuable.
components.trigger: different task regions need different drift widths
components.avoid: every element has the same explicit tolerance

components.name: Drift Suppression
components.purpose: Keep execution aligned after distracting context, repeated transformation, or model error.
components.trigger: long, branching, or iterative work
components.avoid: no semantic baseline or allowed corridor exists

components.name: Per-Region Reasoning Depth
components.purpose: Concentrate analysis and verification where local marginal value is highest instead of applying uniform depth across a task.
components.trigger: task regions vary in difficulty or risk
components.avoid: every unit has the same mandated review depth

components.name: Evidence-Confidence Gate
components.purpose: Keep mixed-certainty reasoning auditable and stop conclusions from laundering inference or hypothesis into fact.
components.trigger: claims of mixed certainty are present
components.avoid: the task contains only direct transformation with no inferential claims

components.name: Minimum Sufficient Explanation
components.purpose: Remove explanatory material that does not change comprehension, verification, decision, or safe execution while retaining required rationale and caveats.
components.trigger: verbosity can obscure the answer
components.avoid: the user requests a tutorial or exhaustive rationale

components.name: External State Automation
components.purpose: Serialize and restore important task state through real files, memory stores, databases, or project documents when the host supports persistence.
components.trigger: continuation requires real external state
components.avoid: the task ends in one session and needs no continuation

components.name: Fail-Closed Abstention
components.purpose: Ensure that missing essential support produces an explicit bounded result rather than fabricated closure.
components.trigger: required evidence cannot be verified
components.avoid: the failed condition is optional and does not affect the supported deliverable

components.name: Non-Compensable Constraint Veto
components.purpose: Preserve non-compensable constraints during aggregation and synthesis.
components.trigger: a defined critical condition must have veto authority
components.avoid: the alleged defect is merely a soft preference

components.name: Forethought / Checkpoints
components.purpose: Catch missing prerequisites and foreseeable downstream failure while reversal is still cheap.
components.trigger: an action is costly, irreversible, or dependency-sensitive
components.avoid: reversible low-cost local edits

components.name: Runtime Compatibility Mode Selector
components.purpose: Keep workflows portable across frontier and smaller models, tool environments, and future hosts without weakening invariant controls.
components.trigger: an implementation targets models with different capabilities
components.avoid: the host and task profile are fixed
task_phrases: deployments with different context and persistence support

components.name: Grounding / No-Invention
components.purpose: Prevent fabricated facts, citations, measurements, policies, records, and gap-filling in source-grounded work.
components.trigger: work relies on documents, data, external facts, or consequential claims
components.avoid: pure creative generation has no asserted factual source boundary

components.name: Explore-Then-Commit Mode
components.purpose: Combine broad planning capability with conservative implementation without letting speculative branch assumptions leak into committed work.
components.trigger: work includes both broad design and grounded execution
components.avoid: the task needs only narrow execution
task_phrases: research plan followed by evidence extraction

components.name: Image Text Fidelity Capture
components.purpose: Create a source-faithful textual representation of image-borne evidence for downstream indexing, analysis, or copying.
components.trigger: an image contains source text to transcribe
components.avoid: no image contains source text or visible structure

components.name: Protected-Constraint Robustness Test
components.purpose: Operationalize the recovered name without pretending the original January 2026 mechanics were recovered.
components.trigger: a patch or rewrite must preserve invariants
components.avoid: the transformed feature is itself decision-relevant

components.name: Workflow Health Monitor
components.purpose: Turn process-health signals into explicit observations that a supervisor can route to repair, pause, or continuation.
components.trigger: process failure signals must be observed
components.avoid: a simple task has no meaningful process state

components.name: Stable-State Recovery Mode
components.purpose: Preserve a trusted task state while isolating drift sources and resuming from one explicit authority-consistent configuration.
components.trigger: coherence degrades under repeated change
components.avoid: one local defect can be repaired directly

components.name: Workflow Repair Supervisor
components.purpose: Coordinate Meta-Awareness, Stuck-Pattern Reset, and Contradiction Micro-Repair without becoming the suite-wide mode and architecture authority.
components.trigger: complex scaffolding itself needs supervision
components.avoid: the task needs suite-wide mode declaration and Core-stack governance

components.name: Minimal Local Correction
components.purpose: Restore local correctness or completeness with the minimum semantic blast radius.
components.trigger: a specific defect has been localized
components.avoid: the artifact architecture is globally wrong

components.name: Micro-Scaffolding
components.purpose: Protect a difficult local operation without loading the full OS, duplicating the parent StateBlock, or leaving permanent context residue.
components.trigger: multi-step or high-constraint work
components.avoid: a one-step task has no fragile constraints

components.name: Mode Lock-In
components.purpose: Keep behavior stable across long sessions, tool calls, and distracting inputs.
components.trigger: a task can drift between modes
components.avoid: exploration intentionally needs rapid mode switching

components.name: Model-Capability Scaffolding Scale
components.purpose: Avoid fossilized over-scaffolding on more reliable models without mistaking model strength for permission to remove essential controls.
components.trigger: adapting a workflow across model capability levels
components.avoid: there is no comparative reliability evidence

components.name: Multi-Layer Consistency
components.purpose: Maintain vertical consistency from local facts and operations to the overall conclusion or system behavior.
components.trigger: multiple authority layers are composed
components.avoid: the artifact has only one meaningful level

components.name: Independent Evidence Gate
components.purpose: Reduce dependence on one fragile source, inference chain, or evaluator before a consequential conclusion is committed.
components.trigger: an important conclusion rests on fragile evidence
components.avoid: the claim is low consequence and one authoritative direct source is sufficient

components.name: Bounded Alternative Search
components.purpose: Obtain real alternative search without losing control of truth, constraints, cost, or convergence.
components.trigger: competing hypotheses or designs would add value
components.avoid: a locked source dictates a single faithful transformation

components.name: Bounded Attention Focus
components.purpose: Increase depth and signal quality on a bounded target when irrelevant material would otherwise dilute effort.
components.trigger: large sources or a narrow debug region demand concentration
components.avoid: the task requires broad discovery before a target is known

components.name: Non-Authoritative Branch Suppression
components.purpose: Prevent attractive but non-governing alternatives from overriding the authoritative task branch.
components.trigger: obsolete alternatives conflict with locked decisions
components.avoid: authority is unresolved

components.name: Parallel Validation System
components.purpose: Match validation topology to failure risk instead of treating QMS as one generic critic or a majority vote.
components.trigger: a composed workflow needs structured quality evaluation
components.avoid: one low-risk deterministic check is sufficient

components.name: Pedagogical Alignment Constraint
components.purpose: Make correct content learnable and usable for a specified audience without diluting claims or inventing simplifications.
components.trigger: an audience or teaching level is known
components.avoid: the audience and purpose cannot be inferred and the choice materially changes content

components.name: Stage-Separated Reasoning Scaffold
components.purpose: Prevent cross-phase contamination while still allowing explicitly governed transitions between reasoning modes.
components.trigger: semantic phase leakage is a risk
components.avoid: a single atomic transformation has no phase transition
task_phrases: long workflows with distinct reasoning modes

components.name: Placeholder Suppression
components.purpose: Prevent scaffolding artifacts from escaping as if they were complete content.
components.trigger: templates or staged artifacts are finalized
components.avoid: the deliverable is explicitly a template whose placeholders are the product

components.name: Deep Exploration Mode
components.purpose: Increase solution search and architectural depth before commitment when the problem is genuinely ambiguous or system-wide.
components.trigger: architecture or design benefits from broad exploration
components.avoid: the task is a precise grounded execution step

components.name: Explore-to-Execute Transition
components.purpose: Narrow a broad exploratory workflow through comparison and selection into precise execution as decisions become locked.
components.trigger: work moves from design to execution
components.avoid: the task is purely exploratory and requires no commitment
task_phrases: creative work with a committed deliverable

components.name: Task-Scope Reasoning Controller
components.purpose: Match reasoning depth and scope to the unit of work instead of applying either shallow local analysis or system-wide architecture indiscriminately.
components.trigger: task complexity or risk requires depth selection
components.avoid: a governing workflow already fixes the required scale

components.name: Reasoning Efficiency Controller
components.purpose: Maximize useful completed work per unit time while respecting the Cognitive Governor's budget and every mandatory validation barrier.
components.trigger: latency, breadth, and validation compete
components.avoid: the task is one atomic operation

components.name: Checkpointed Work Reflection
components.purpose: Correct process and output errors at meaningful checkpoints without turning reflection into unbounded rumination or invented content.
components.trigger: output needs a deliberate quality pass
components.avoid: a deterministic fix is already known and reflection adds no decision value

components.name: Full-Structure Invariant-Preserving Rewrite
components.purpose: Replace a systemically broken expression or structure without losing verified content, requirements, provenance, or accepted decisions.
components.trigger: architecture or source mapping is globally broken
components.avoid: one sentence or field is wrong

components.name: Cross-Module Coordination
components.purpose: Coordinate active modules that should reinforce one another while suppressing irrelevant effects and preserving authority boundaries.
components.trigger: several active modules must align
components.avoid: only one module is active

components.name: Cross-Module Coordination Rule Builder
components.purpose: Make useful cross-module reinforcement explicit and reusable without merging modules, duplicating content, or granting hidden communication.
components.trigger: the same module relationship recurs
components.avoid: the need is a general task behavior unrelated to module coupling

components.name: Risk-Tier Scaling
components.purpose: Apply proportionate rigor so low-risk tasks remain efficient and high-risk claims or actions receive stronger evidence and fail-closed handling.
components.trigger: task risk varies or must be classified
components.avoid: a binding protocol already specifies the exact controls
task_phrases: medical, legal, financial, or safety-sensitive work

components.name: Conservative Execution Mode
components.purpose: Protect factual and consequential execution after the plan is chosen or whenever uncertainty and impact require constrained behavior.
components.trigger: execution is factual, consequential, or uncertain
components.avoid: the primary need is broad architecture discovery

components.name: Safe Rewrite Logic
components.purpose: Make paraphrase, polish, tone, or formatting safe by treating content atoms as invariants rather than suggestions.
components.trigger: paraphrasing, polishing, or format conversion
components.avoid: the user asks to change substantive meaning

components.name: Scoped Loader / Loader Sequencing
components.purpose: Keep modular OS or Skill execution relevant, ordered, and within context limits instead of loading the full library at session start.
components.trigger: a modular workflow has multiple available components
components.avoid: the workflow has one small fixed instruction set

components.name: Automatic Canonical-State Update
components.purpose: Reduce stale state and forgotten deltas during iterative work.
components.trigger: the host can update explicit state after steps
components.avoid: the host cannot write persistent state

components.name: Ordered Memory-State Update Engine
components.purpose: Preserve sequence, provenance, relevance, and current truth across long-running work.
components.trigger: state changes across steps or source chunks
components.avoid: a one-shot task has no state evolution

components.name: Unsupported Precision Gate
components.purpose: Provide a conservative modern interpretation of the recovered name while keeping the historical source gap explicit.
components.trigger: precise details may be plausible but unsupported
components.avoid: exact values are directly provided and verified

components.name: Stable Long-Context
components.purpose: Extend usable context duration without treating the entire transcript as equally current or important.
components.trigger: large corpus or long-running workflow
components.avoid: all relevant material fits clearly in one short exchange

components.name: Task-State Handoff Router
components.purpose: Pass explicit task state, decisions, evidence pointers, and module outputs through real host-supported handoffs.
components.trigger: multiple components must exchange typed state
components.avoid: all work occurs inside one uninterrupted component

components.name: State Snapshot
components.purpose: Create a stable checkpoint that can be resumed or audited after interruption.
components.trigger: a workflow pauses, hands off, or persists
components.avoid: a snapshot would persist prohibited sensitive data

components.name: Canonical Task State
components.purpose: Give tools, agents, validators, and handoffs a shared source of current task truth.
components.trigger: work spans multiple steps or components
components.avoid: a trivial one-turn task needs no persistent state

components.name: Structured Refinement Cycles
components.purpose: Prevent one revision pass from trading away correctness while improving structure or style.
components.trigger: revision has multiple defect classes
components.avoid: only one bounded defect exists
task_phrases: reports requiring source and style review

components.name: Structured State Projection
components.purpose: Reduce context, privacy, and authority leakage between components.
components.trigger: a component needs a bounded state view
components.avoid: one trusted consumer legitimately needs the whole safe state

components.name: Stuck-Pattern Reset Pack
components.purpose: Break nonproductive loops without erasing the trustworthy task context needed for a genuinely different next attempt.
components.trigger: reasoning loops or stale approaches repeat
components.avoid: a second attempt has new evidence or a materially changed method

components.name: Style-Alignment Module
components.purpose: Make artifacts consistent with audience, publication, or organizational style while keeping truth and requirements dominant.
components.trigger: a style or voice is specified
components.avoid: the requested style impersonates a living person or conflicts with policy

components.name: Structural System Edit
components.purpose: Make macro changes to layers, cores, workflows, or incompatible interfaces without losing invariants, dependents, or rollback control.
components.trigger: layers, Cores, or workflows require major replacement
components.avoid: a localized invariant-preserving patch suffices

components.name: Task-Set Lock-In
components.purpose: Prevent scope substitution and goal drift during execution.
components.trigger: multi-step work begins or scope changes
components.avoid: the task is still materially ambiguous

components.name: Temporal Anchor Scaffold
components.purpose: Prevent chronology errors and confusion between event time, publication time, and current validity.
components.trigger: time or chronology affects correctness
components.avoid: time has no bearing on the answer

components.name: Truth Priority Hierarchy
components.purpose: Resolve conflicting signals without letting fluency, optimization, or an undifferentiated vote override stronger evidence or safety authority.
components.trigger: evidence classes or authorities conflict
components.avoid: no material evidence or authority conflict exists
task_phrases: domain decisions with mixed evidence classes

components.name: Independent Evidence Redundancy
components.purpose: Reduce single-point truth failure before high-impact synthesis or decision-making.
components.trigger: a consequential claim can be independently checked
components.avoid: the claim is low risk and an authoritative primary source is decisive

components.name: Dual-Source Bounded Synthesis
components.purpose: Enable useful synthesis without losing redundant factual grounding.
components.trigger: source-grounded synthesis permits bounded interpretation
components.avoid: only one defensible anchor exists

components.name: Suite-Wide Workflow Supervisor
components.purpose: Keep a large OS or skill suite operating as one authority-consistent system across planning, execution, repair, and finalization.
components.trigger: a large suite needs top-level coordination
components.avoid: one small skill can complete the task

components.name: Working-Memory Cues
components.purpose: Keep easily forgotten but relevant information salient during execution.
components.trigger: many constraints must remain active
components.avoid: the cue duplicates already salient text
task_phrases: tasks with a few recurring constraints

components.name: Working-Memory Lock-In
components.purpose: Prevent critical goals, constraints, identifiers, or safety conditions from being displaced by incoming context.
components.trigger: critical state competes with large context
components.avoid: nothing needs continuous salience

components.name: Immutable Content Zones
components.purpose: Protect facts, identifiers, quotations, obligations, safety limits, and other high-consequence content from transformation drift.
components.trigger: content contains fidelity-locked atoms
components.avoid: the user explicitly authorizes change to the marked content
